answer: Honeypot seats make each fake key's grading its own liability. Every key that grades through the tide, a run of 20 seats, meets 4 planted junk answers it cannot tell from real ones. Passing a junk answer burns 30 POA of that key's bond and forfeits the nectar it earned this epoch, 5 POA. Copying a trellis of scores fails because the 4 traps sit at different seats per key. A guessing fake passes 2 of 4 traps, losing 2 x 35 = 70 POA, so 1,000 fakes x 70 POA = 70,000 POA, and the attacker pays 70,000 POA.
